hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
if [ -f "/usr/local/docker-config/setProxy.sh" ]; then . /usr/local/docker-config/setProxy.sh fi
cd services/pic-sure-ai-service
# Logging [[ -d "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/logging" ]] && INCLUDE_LOGGING=true || INCLUDE_LOGGING=false echo "INCLUDE_LOGGING=$INCLUDE_LOGGING"
if $INCLUDE_LOGGING; then set -a . "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/logging/logging.env" set +a LOGGING_ENVS="-e LOGGING_API_KEY=$LOGGING_API_KEY -e LOGGING_SERVICE_URL=$LOGGING_SERVICE_URL" if [[ -z "${LOGGING_API_KEY:-}" ]]; then echo "WARNING: Logging is enabled but LOGGING_API_KEY is empty in logging.env" fi if [[ -z "${LOGGING_SERVICE_URL:-}" ]]; then echo "WARNING: Logging is enabled but LOGGING_SERVICE_URL is empty in logging.env" fi else LOGGING_ENVS="" echo "Logging disabled (no $DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/logging/ directory)" fi
# Version control GIT_BRANCH_SHORT=`echo ${GIT_BRANCH} | cut -d "/" -f 2` GIT_COMMIT_SHORT=`echo ${GIT_COMMIT} | cut -c1-7`
# Env files cp /usr/local/docker-config/ai-service/ai-service.env .env CONFIG_DIR="/usr/local/docker-config/ai-service" mkdir -p "$CONFIG_DIR"
if [ -f ai-service.env ]; then echo "A new ai-service.env was loaded." cp ai-service.env "$CONFIG_DIR/ai-service.env" elif [ -f "$CONFIG_DIR/ai-service.env" ]; then echo "Using existing ai-service.env" else echo "ERROR: ai-service.env is required at $CONFIG_DIR/ai-service.env" exit 2 fi
# Build and run docker run --rm \ -v "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/jenkins_home/workspace/$JOB_NAME/:/app" \ -v maven_m2_cache:/root/.m2 \ -w /app \ --platform=linux/amd64 \ -e MAVEN_OPTS="-Xmx2g" \ maven:3-amazoncorretto-25 \ sh -lc "mvn -B clean install -T 3 -DskipTests -pl services/pic-sure-ai-service -am"
docker build -t hms-dbmi/pic-sure-ai-service:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT} -f Dockerfile . docker tag hms-dbmi/pic-sure-ai-service:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT} hms-dbmi/pic-sure-ai-service:LATEST
docker stop pic-sure-ai-service && docker rm pic-sure-ai-service docker run --name=pic-sure-ai-service --restart always --network=picsure \ --env-file $CONFIG_DIR/ai-service.env \ $LOGGING_ENVS \ -v /Users/samanthapiatt/.aws:/home/app/.aws:rw \ -d hms-dbmi/pic-sure-ai-service:LATEST \ || exit 2 docker start pic-sure-ai-service
